class.name: OpenWorldTerrainData
class.description: [OpenWorldTerrainData] stores sparse terrain tiles for the experimental open-world terrain renderer. Each created tile owns normalized height values and manual layer paint values that are uploaded by [OpenWorldTerrain3D] as per-tile GPU textures.

method.name: create_height_image
method.description: Returns a [constant Image.FORMAT_RF] image containing the normalized height data.

method.name: create_layer_image
method.description: Returns a [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] image containing manual layer paint data. RGB stores low, mid, and high layer weights; alpha stores how strongly painted weights override automatic splatting.

method.name: create_tile
method.description: Creates a flat terrain tile at integer grid coordinate [param cell] if it does not already exist.

method.name: fill_flat
method.description: Fills the full height field with one normalized value in the [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code] range.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the normalized height at heightmap texel coordinate [param x], [param y].

method.name: get_height_index
method.description: Returns the row-major array index for heightmap texel coordinate [param x], [param y].

method.name: get_layer
method.description: Returns the manual layer paint value at heightmap texel coordinate [param x], [param y].

method.name: get_tile_height_data
method.description: Returns the normalized height data for the created tile at [param cell].

method.name: get_tile_layer_data
method.description: Returns the manual layer paint data for the created tile at [param cell].

method.name: has_tile
method.description: Returns whether a terrain tile exists at integer grid coordinate [param cell].

method.name: remove_tile
method.description: Removes the terrain tile at integer grid coordinate [param cell] if it exists.

method.name: resize
method.description: Updates the heightmap resolution and terrain world size. Existing values are preserved by array prefix unless [param clear_existing] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_height
method.description: Sets the normalized height at heightmap texel coordinate [param x], [param y].

method.name: set_layer
method.description: Sets the manual layer paint value at heightmap texel coordinate [param x], [param y].

members.member: Integer grid coordinates for tiles that exist in this sparse terrain resource.
Normalized height values stored in row-major order.
World-space vertical scale applied by [OpenWorldTerrain3D]'s displacement shader.
Manual layer paint values stored in row-major order. RGB represents low, mid, and high weights. Alpha controls how much the painted weights override automatic height/slope splatting.
Width and height, in vertices/texels, of each created tile heightmap. A value of [code]257[/code] creates [code]256[/code] quads per tile edge.
World-space size of one terrain tile edge. Cell [code](0, 0)[/code] covers local X/Z [code]0.0[/code] to [member tile_world_size].
